name: OmaOvercast
author: RobertStevenson
description: Unofficial Overcast player for the Omarchy bar: browse your subscriptions, play episodes with mpv, and sync progress and speed back to your Overcast account.

barWidget.description: Your Overcast podcasts and episodes, played with mpv, with progress synced to your account.

schema.label: Show artwork
schema.description: Show podcast artwork in the list and now-playing card.

schema.label: Accent color
schema.description: Use Overcast orange, or the current Omarchy theme's accent color, for controls and highlights.

schema.label: Older episodes
schema.description: How many episodes older than the ones in your Overcast library to show for each podcast.
